subject: Re: Sponsorship matchback request for comparative RFP evaluation
messages:
From: Anika Shah <anika.shah@altamed.ai>
To: rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2026-09-17T09:14:00-07:00
Subject: Comparative RFP – request for sponsorship to match incumbent credits

Hi Rachel,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team liked the latency profile and the rollout controls. We are running a tight RFP and the incumbent vendor has offered a deep sandbox credit package that shifts the economics for our bake-off.

Short ask: would Redwood consider a sponsorship (one-time credit allocation) on par with the incumbent so we can run side-by-side benchmarks across our integration tests and a user-simulated workload? We estimate ~1.5M tokens over 4 weeks (detailed in attached usage-plan).

Key constraints:
- We need isolated project keys and a short-term data retention policy for logs.
- Can we get an authorization letter for procurement that shows the sponsored amount and the conditions?

If it helps, the RFP timeline is tight — decision expected by early October. Happy to hop on a 20-min call to go through the workload specifics.

Best,
Anika Shah
Head of Platform Partnerships
AltaMed AI

Attachment: usage-plan-altamed.xlsx (spreadsheet — 1 sheet, token estimates and test scenarios)

From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com>
To: Anika Shah <anika.shah@altamed.ai>
Cc: ben.carter@redwoodinference.com, grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2026-09-17T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Comparative RFP – request for sponsorship to match incumbent credits

Hi Anika —

Appreciate the clear ask and the usage spreadsheet. We can support a time-bound sponsorship to ensure AltaMed can run an apples-to-apples eval. Provisional offer: 1.25M token credits provisioned to an isolated project for 30 days, plus short-term log retention of 14 days (extendable on approval).

A couple of logistics we need to confirm before we lock this:
- Legal/procurement will need an authorization letter that lists the sponsored amount, permitted use (benchmarking/testing only), and expiration.
- We require a short intake form from your SRE describing concurrency and peak qps, so our serving team can reserve capacity.
- Please confirm you are not ingesting PHI; if you are, we need a scoped SOC/controls review (can be expedited).

If that looks good I will route to Ben for final credit approval and ask ops to create the isolated keys. Can you share a preferred billing contact for the authorization letter?

Thanks,
Rachel
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

--

Subject: Re: Comparative RFP – request for sponsorship to match incumbent credits

Rachel —

Thanks for the summary. Approved with conditions: we can allocate up to 1.25M tokens for the isolated evaluation project for 30 days. Conditions:

1) Tracked usage tied to the HubSpot deal (RDW-2026-ALTA-0917) and a 14-day post-eval usage report.
2) Credits only apply to eval usage — no production or customer-facing systems.
3) If their workload shows sustained production-like traffic during the eval (concurrency > 200 qps for > 1 hour), ops reserves the right to throttle and pause credits — will notify the customer first.
4) Marketing/success: we want to collect anonymized benchmark results and permission to use a one-paragraph case study if they choose Redwood.

Grace — please create the authorization letter and include the exact language for permitted use + expiry. Ops: please provision the project keys once Grace confirms the wording and procurement contact.

Ben
Director, Sales Operations
Redwood Inference
